mathematics.assertion_tested: Free elliptical Sersic lens+sky shape fits to actual VIS/Y/J/H pixels with normalized PSFs, source/artefact mask dilation1/2/3, PSF-overlap halo controls and secondary published-source subtraction; joint n/Re profile maps and finite renderer benchmarks.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE754 float64; native per-band image/RMS units; arcsecond coordinates
mathematics.conventions: Unit-total-flux elliptical major-axis Sersic model integrated within pixels, convolved with normalized supplied PSF with padded model support; core3x3 pixels use angular quadrature of incomplete-gamma radial primitive. Free intensity and sky profiled linearly. No catalogue shape priors, only starts.
inputs: Released8band100x100FITS withPSFs/RMS and masks; VISCOOLESTshape initialization; released source images only for explicitly secondary subtraction.
non_claims: No source-prior-independent uncontaminated NIR n/Re measurement from small dilation masks.
PSF overlap is geometric, not a strict source contamination flux bound.
No covariance correction for correlated resampled noise; profile intervals conditional.
No conversion of band-shape differences into measured stellar M/L gradient.
No theory pass/fail or lensing-mass fit.
